answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 21860 Country: India Title: i am a doctor.i want to ask if i marry a doctor & she wish to get post graduation in obstetrics&gynecology,1.should i allow her or not as i know situation is very bad in medical colleges?2.should i allow her to work in any hospital?3.what about the salary she earn?can i use it or its upto her?because she may wish to give it to her parents?please guide me.Jazakallahu khairan. Question: i am a doctor.i want to ask if i marry a doctor & she wish to get post graduation in obstetrics&gynecology,1.should i allow her or not as i know situation is very bad in medical colleges?2.should i allow her to work in any hospital?3.what about the salary she earn?can i use it or its upto her?because she may wish to give it to her parents?please guide me.Jazakallahu khairan. Answer ID: 21860 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 842/652/B=1431) If she avoids unlawful acts you can allow her for work. Whatever she earns she alone would be its owner, you will not have any right in it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
